_comment: Shot list for episode 7, first of four on the Law. 16 new paintings (prompts below, generated in this order) plus the title and close backgrounds; shared stills: the scroll, Brian's Navy photograph, Brian's picture, the series map (maps/ep07.png). No imagined scenes are spoken in this series; the paintings are places and things the text names. The title and close cards have their lettering added afterwards (title_card.jpg, close_card.jpg).
style: Painterly oil-sketch look, visible brushwork, warm natural light, the land and buildings of ancient Israel and its neighbours. No faces shown close up: people are seen from behind or at a distance. No text or lettering anywhere. No modern objects. Calm and hopeful, never frightening or graphic. 16:9.

shots.prompt: A path through quiet hills at dawn divides in two around a standing stone, one way down into a valley, one way up along a ridge.
shots.description: A dirt path through quiet hills at dawn divides in two around a single standing stone, one way going down into a valley and one way going up along a ridge, soft mist in the low places, no people.

shots.at_phrase: If someone says a door is open
shots.prompt: The wooden door of a stone house stands wide open onto a sunlit courtyard, a clay jar beside the step.
shots.description: The wooden door of a simple stone house in an ancient village, standing wide open onto a sunlit courtyard, a clay jar beside the step, morning light falling through the doorway, no people.
The path dividing around the standing stone again.

shots.prompt: A great bare granite mountain in the desert at first light, a wide plain below and the smoke of distant tents.
shots.description: A great bare granite mountain in the desert at first light, its peaks catching gold, a wide plain of sand and scrub below, a thin line of smoke from distant tents on the plain, no figures close up.
The mountain in the desert again.
A photograph treated to match the paintings: Brian as a young sailor in Navy whites, with Patti beside him. A small plate beneath him reads Mister Scaredy Cat.
The picture that marks Brian's own words.

shots.prompt: A single rough stone lies across a narrow dusty footpath between low stone walls, the tip of a walking staff entering from the edge.
shots.description: Close to the ground on a narrow dusty footpath between low stone walls, a single rough stone lies across the path, long morning shadows, the tip of a wooden walking staff just entering the picture from the edge. No people.

shots.card:
Not By Sight
Episode 7: The stumbling block
shots.prompt: Title card over a quiet road at dusk with a single stone lying in it: Not By Sight, episode seven, the stumbling block.
shots.description: Title card background only: a quiet road through hill country at dusk, a single stone lying in the road in the foreground, the sky deep blue with the first stars, no people, no text, keep the lower third calm.

shots.prompt: A vast camp of dark tents across a desert plain at the foot of the mountain, smoke rising, small figures and flocks far off.
shots.description: A vast camp of dark goat-hair tents spread across a desert plain at the foot of a great granite mountain, cooking smoke rising, small figures and flocks far off among the tents, late afternoon light.

The series map. Jerusalem and Shechem are marked in gold. Facing north from Jerusalem, Shechem is at twelve o'clock, about a day and a half's walk. Mount Sinai lies far to the south, off the bottom edge of the map.
The open scroll in warm light. The Scripture reader begins.

shots.prompt: A field at sunset after harvest; a landowner, seen from behind, counts coins into a labourer's open hand.
shots.description: A field at sunset after the harvest, stubble and sheaves, a landowner seen from behind counting coins into the open hand of a labourer, both small in the frame, long golden light, a village on the hill beyond.
The open scroll. Moses commands the ceremony.

shots.at_phrase: And these tribes shall stand on Mount Ebal
shots.prompt: Two broad mountains facing each other across a narrow valley, a small walled town between them, terraces and olive trees.
shots.description: Two broad rounded mountains facing each other across a narrow green valley in the hill country, a small walled town of stone houses in the valley between them, terraced slopes and olive trees, clear afternoon light, no figures close up.
The open scroll again.

shots.prompt: Two great mountain slopes covered with a vast crowd, and in the valley between them a small group of priests around a gold-covered chest.
shots.description: Seen from high above and far away: two great mountain slopes covered with a vast crowd of people in plain robes, so many they look like a texture on the hills, and in the valley between them a small group of priests around a gold-covered chest. Bright clear light. No faces visible.
The stone in the path again.
The open scroll. The word in other places.

shots.prompt: A large clay water jar fallen on a stone path, broken, water spreading on the stones.
shots.description: A large clay water jar fallen on a stone path, broken into several pieces, a dark splash of water spreading on the stones, dust in the air, soft late light, no people.
The open scroll. The gentle one.

shots.at_phrase: Perish. Die. Fall and be broken.
shots.description: The broken jar again.
The mountain at first light again.

shots.prompt: A minister's study in England in the early 1700s: a desk by a tall window, quill, candle and books; a man in a dark coat seated writing, seen from behind.
shots.description: A minister's study in England in the early 1700s: a heavy wooden writing desk by a tall window, a quill and inkpot, a candle, a large open book, shelves of leather-bound books, grey English daylight. A man in a dark coat and white bands is seated writing, seen from behind. No readable words anywhere.
Matthew Henry's study.
The stone in the path again.

shots.prompt: A room in a Roman house: a man seated at a low table writing on a scroll, seen from behind, Roman rooftops through the doorway.
shots.description: A room in a Roman house in the first century: a man in a plain tunic and cloak sits at a low table writing on a scroll, seen from behind, an oil lamp, painted plaster walls, a column and a glimpse of red-tiled Roman rooftops through the doorway. No readable words anywhere.

shots.at_phrase: So this is what a Jewish writer
shots.prompt: A lone traveller with a staff, small and seen from behind, walks down into an empty valley at dusk while the true road curves away along the ridge.
shots.description: A lone traveller with a walking staff, very small in the distance and seen from behind, walks down into a wide empty valley at dusk while the true road curves away along the ridge in the foreground. Long shadows, quiet and a little lonely, not frightening.
Matthew Henry's study again.
The path dividing around the standing stone.
The whole people on the two mountains again.
The picture that marks Brian's own words.

shots.prompt: A tall black stone monument in a sunlit Babylonian courtyard, a carved relief of a seated king at the top and the rest covered in fine carved writing.
shots.description: A tall black basalt stone monument standing in a sunlit courtyard in ancient Babylon, rounded at the top, a carved relief at the top of a seated king facing a standing figure, the rest of the stone covered in fine carved marks too small to read. Mud-brick walls, palm trees, hot light. No people close up.

shots.at_phrase: So is the Bible first? Not quite.
shots.prompt: The bank of the Nile in the evening: an old man and a boy sit side by side above the water, seen from behind, a sailing boat on the river.
shots.description: The bank of the Nile in Egypt in the evening: an old man and a boy sit side by side on a low wall above the water, seen from behind, reeds and palm trees, a small sailing boat on the river, warm low sun. Their faces are not shown.

shots.at_phrase: As far as the shelf can tell
shots.description: The mountain at first light.
The stone in the path.

shots.at_phrase: And suppose a traveller asks the way
shots.description: The traveller walking down into the wrong valley.

shots.at_phrase: The Law did what law can do
shots.description: The whole people on the two mountains.
The picture that marks Brian's own words.

shots.prompt: Night over the hill country, the sky thick with stars, a sleeping village with one lamp lit in a window and a path running past it.
shots.description: Night over quiet hill country, the sky thick with stars, a small village asleep on a hillside with one lamp still lit in a window, a single path running past it in the starlight, no people.

shots.prompt: A man with a small bundle walks out through an open gate into morning light, seen from behind.
shots.description: A man in a plain worn tunic with a small bundle over his shoulder walks out through an open wooden gate in a stone wall into bright morning light and open country, seen from behind. Hopeful.

shots.card:
For we walk by faith, not by sight.
2 Corinthians 5:7

shots.prompt: Closing card over dawn in the valley between the two mountains: For we walk by faith, not by sight, and the address blindnessinthebible.com.
shots.description: Closing card background only: dawn over the narrow valley between two broad mountains in the hill country, light mist in the valley, olive terraces, a wide clear sky, no people, no text, keep the upper half calm.
